summary: The acceptance candidate does not satisfy the stated representative-plane measurement contract. Signal-width selection discards unavailable measurements before choosing the largest-area plane, silently substituting a smaller plane instead of leaving width missing. Primary specimen reporting also pairs signal width with a length selected independently through the mask-chord-width path, although a correctly paired signal-plane length exists. In addition, the cited RC6 validation receipt is not commit-bound to the substantially changed measurement implementation at the reviewed commit. These defects can change primary length, width, and ratio summaries and block acceptance. The measurements establish calibrated image-derived geometry only; they do not establish absolute nuclear diameter, molecular chromatin width, anatomical organ volume, or a biological group effect.

findings.title: Largest-area representative plane is bypassed when its signal width is missing
findings.impact: A track whose designated largest-area plane has unavailable FWHM receives width, length, and ratio from a smaller plane. This is availability-conditioned substitution, contradicts the declared missing-value contract, and can bias specimens or groups whose largest-plane widths fail at different rates.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:6178-6185 filters nonfinite widths before representative-area ranking.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:6193-6225 ranks and selects only the surviving width-available planes.
tests/test_saturn_v571_intensity_width_contract.py:89-112 tests representative selection only when both planes have valid widths.
tests/test_saturn_v571_body_width.py:255-272 tests complete unavailability only and does not exercise partial missingness.
findings.recommendation: Select the representative technically valid plane using area, support, and Z before inspecting FWHM availability. Copy the same-plane length and tortuosity, and leave FWHM and its ratio missing if that plane lacks a valid width. Add adversarial tests where the largest-area plane alone is unavailable and where availability differs by morphology.

findings.title: Primary summaries can pair signal width with length from a different Z plane
findings.impact: The displayed primary length and signal width need not describe the same cross-section. This breaks geometric interpretability and makes the reported length/width pair inconsistent with the correctly computed same-plane ratio.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:6226-6244 stores the correctly paired representative_signal_profile_length_um and signal-width ratio.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:6254-6353 independently selects representative_body_length_um through body-width availability.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:8843-8849 reports representative_body_length_um beside signal-profile FWHM width.

findings.recommendation: Route representative_signal_profile_length_um everywhere that signal-profile FWHM width or its ratio is the primary comparative geometry. Retain representative_body_length_um only under an explicitly mask-chord-plane QC name. Add a test where mask-chord and signal-width availability force different selected planes and assert table, CSV, figure, and PDF consistency.

findings.title: Cited validation evidence predates the current measurement implementation
findings.impact: The retained image, tracking, and report evidence cannot establish that the reviewed commit's new width, area, merge, and reporting semantics operate correctly on real candidate data.

findings.recommendation: After correcting representative-plane routing, produce a commit-bound focused replay or validation receipt for the reviewed measurement implementation. It must bind source hashes, source tables, primary report tables/figures, missing-width behavior, and known-geometry adversarial tests without requiring a full inference rerun if a content-bound replay is sufficient.

findings.title: Physical interpretation remains deliberately limited
findings.impact: Even after software correction, FWHM is an apparent optical signal width under undersampling and PSF effects; mask slab sums and repeated 2D ROI normalizations are not anatomical volumes. These quantities alone cannot establish nuclear molecular diameter, organ volume, or genotype effect.

limitations: No full image stack was run, as prohibited by the review request.
Focused pytest execution was blocked before collection because the read-only environment had no writable temporary directory; test results are therefore not claimed for this session.
The review did not inspect other reviewers' outputs.
Visual overlays were not used to infer numerical correctness; the numerical trace relied on source, focused tests, and commit-bound evidence manifests/receipts.
recommended_follow_up: Correct representative-plane selection so missing FWHM on the predetermined largest-area technically valid plane remains missing.
Use representative_signal_profile_length_um as the primary length paired with signal-profile FWHM width throughout specimen tables, figures, PDFs, and group comparisons.
Add synthetic adversarial tests for partial plane-level missingness, divergent mask-width/signal-width availability, ties, nonfinite areas, invalid centerlines, rotation, and edge clipping.
Generate a new commit-bound focused measurement replay and report-consistency receipt after remediation, then run a superseding independent measurement_geometry audit.
